definitions.gloss: work; piece (of art, writing, or craft); production
definitions.explanation: A finished creative work — a novel, film, painting, ceramic piece, or similar. Often used as a suffix (e.g., {新作|しんさく} 'new work') and as a counter-like noun in titles and reviews.

examples.japanese: この{作|さく}は{彼|かれ}のデビュー{作|さく}です。
examples.english: This work is his debut piece.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}な{陶芸家|とうげいか}の{作|さく}が{展覧会|てんらんかい}に{並|なら}んでいた。
examples.english: Works by a famous ceramic artist were displayed at the exhibition.

notes:
Most often appears as a suffix attached to another noun: {新作|しんさく} 'new work', {名作|めいさく} 'masterpiece', {自信作|じしんさく} 'work one is confident in'. As a standalone word it is mainly literary or used in art/craft labels.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新作|しんさく}: new work; latest work
- {名作|めいさく}: masterpiece; classic
- {大作|たいさく}: major work; epic
- {駄作|ださく}: poor/worthless work
- デビュー{作|さく}: debut work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {作品|さくひん}: work; production — the more common standalone word for a creative piece
- {著作|ちょさく}: written work — limited to writings; emphasizes authorship
